thread:
release-bot: Deploy window open for persona-router v1.10.0. Rolling rollout plan is regional-staggered. Feature flag `persona.route.v1.steadyflow` will be 0% -> us-west 2% -> eu-central 2% -> global 12% over 50m. Change window 00:30-03:00 UTC. Notifying @zara @kevin @marta.

zara: ack. I'll watch region split charts, p50/p95 per-region, and any cross-region fallback counts. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/releases/persona-router/v1.10.0/runbook (note: includes regional checklist).

kevin: adding auto-pin conditions: sustained per-region 5xx >1.0% for 3m OR p95 +220ms -> pin region to v1.9.5 for that cohort. Also enable `circuit-breaker:route-fallback` so traffic can fallback to cheaper region if latency spikes.

marta: recommend turning off the high-quant shard in eu-central until we hit 8% there. That reduced memory churn in previous runs. Also let's enable canary-bot verbose sampling on first two minutes after each region advance.

release-bot: Plan updated. Steps:
1) toggle us-west to 2% flag
2) wait 10m, check metrics + canary-bot samples
3) toggle eu-central to 2%
4) after stable, move both to 12% over remaining window
Auto-pin: per-region pin to v1.9.5. Posting brief note to #release-notes.

ops-bot: Preflight ok: infra healthy, multi-region db lag <0.5s, GPU headroom us-west 34% eu-central 29%. Alerts armed to page @kevin on per-region error rules.

kevin: running initial toggle for us-west in ~1m. command I'll use:
```
/redwood flag set --name persona.route.v1.steadyflow --region us-west --pct 2 --who kevin --note "regional stagger: us-west step1"
```

canary-bot: starting verbose sample capture for us-west canary cohort. posting a short sample digest every 2m to the thread.

zara: metrics at us-west 2% after 6m: p95 baseline 180ms -> 195ms, 5xx 0.3% -> 0.5% (ok). canary-bot samples look fine. Holding for the 10m window.

canary-bot: sample digest (us-west): 20 samples, avg perplexity change 0.6%, semantic-safety checks passed. top tokens OK.

release-bot: Proceeding with eu-central step in 4m unless aborted.

marta: advancing eu-central to 2% now and keeping high-quant disabled there:
```
/redwood flag set --name persona.route.v1.steadyflow --region eu-central --pct 2 --who marta --note "regional stagger: eu-central step1, quant off"
```

zara: eu-central metrics after 5m: p95 baseline 210ms -> 260ms, 5xx jumped to 1.4% at 01:22. Paging @kevin.

kevin: investigating traces trace-eu-11 and trace-eu-13. I see a stale-KV checksum mismatch causing retries and downstream 5xx. Noting this looks infra-related, not model drift. Initiating manual per-region pin to v1.9.5 to stop the spike for eu-central:
```
/release pin --service persona-router --region eu-central --version v1.9.5 --who kevin --reason "stale-KV checksum causing 5xx during ramp"
```

release-bot: Manual per-region pin recorded at 8675309068 by kevin. eu-central cohorts pinned to v1.9.5 and v1.10.0 nodes in eu are draining. Posting rollback note to #release-notes: "v1.10.0 regional ramp paused in eu-central due to stale-KV checksum mismatches; eu-central pinned to v1.9.5 while infra investigates; us-west remains at 2%."

marta: opening infra ticket with traces, sample inputs and KV checksums. assigning to infra-kv and regionops.

ops-bot: suggestion: block global advance until stale-KV fix and a rolling rehydrate of KV across replicas. Recommend a 24h soak on staging + run a KV repair job. Also propose next ramp attempt: us-west 5% -> eu 1% -> global 12% with a longer hold.

zara: agreed. I'll update release ticket and release notes, add follow-up action items: KV repair job, staging soak, re-run canary-bot sampling. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

canary-bot: posting final digest: us-west samples stable; eu-central capture halted at spike.

release-bot: Closing window for eu-central. Leaving us-west at 2% as an observational cohort. Reattempt conditions: KV repair merged + 12h staging soak + green canary-bot run.
